messages:
alex.m: Heads-up — customer X pushed back on our BYOK + retention timeline. They need a way to get evidence exports on day 0 for legal holds. Can we sketch an MVP that doesn’t derail launch?
priya: Do they need full audit-stream exports or just a snapshot of tenant activity (auth + request metadata)?
jordan: Pics — full stream would be heavy. we could offer a nearline export: daily batch + API to request snapshot. cheaper than realtime streaming.
samir (security): For SOC2/ISO evidence we need immutability guarantees. Day-0 export is fine if we sign an export contract that says customer is responsible for storage after handoff. legal needs to OK liability.
maria (legal): +1 to handoff liability but need to define retention windows we support in contract. also require HMAC-signed manifests so exported artifacts are tamper-evident.
alex.m: Proposed short-term path: 1) offer a 90-day evidence-onramp (daily signed snapshots + one-off legal-hold export API) 2) gated pilot for 3 customers 3) long-term: integrated BYOK + tenant-anchored retention buckets (1y/3y/7y) with SLA. Thoughts?
priya: Implementation notes: daily snapshot = write-to-s3-compatible bucket in customer vpc or our secure staging (if they don't have VPC). Include manifest.json with sha256 list. We can reuse current audit pipeline + small exporter. Estimated 2 sprint effort for basic export + 1 sprint for manifest signing.
jordan: Ops questions: who manages ephemeral keys if we host the bucket? we need rotation + key escrow. If customer uses BYOK, we can encrypt at rest using their key. Otherwise a signed manifest still ok.
samir (security): For the pilot, require the following gating checks before we hand off: - HMAC manifest enabled - Signed export artifacts - Export ACLs validated - Playbook for legal hold restore path
ops-bot: deploy  /exports/pilot  queued by @priya — ETA 2d for staging config.
maria (legal): Contract asks: limit Redwood liability for exported data, require customer to attest secure storage, include incident notification SLA on export verification failures. Also need retention tiering in contract language (we don't promise infinite archive unless paid).
alex.m: Pricing & product tradeoff: exporting daily snapshots for free will increase costs. propose paid add-on: Evidence Onramp (metered by GB exported + verification runs). Pilot customers can get waiver.
priya: Developer checklist (minimal): - export endpoint (/v1/exports/tenants/:id) - manifest signing (HMAC with service key) - retention metadata in manifest - verification job that runs post-export (checks checksums)
alex.m: Example manifest snippet we can ship in pilot: ```json
{"tenant_id":"T-123","export_time":"2026-04-10T00:00:00Z","files":[{"path":"auth.log.gz","sha256":"..."}],"retention_policy":"90d","signed_by":"redwood-export-svc"}
```
samir (security): Add note: manifests must include keystore fingerprint if BYOK used.
maria (legal): Also require an audit trail of who requested exports (user id + approval record) — we need that recorded server-side.
jordan: Ops constraints: storage delta beyond 500GB/mo triggers rate-limited onboarding + infra cost review. We should surface projected cost to sales as part of the pilot onboarding doc.
alex.m: Next steps: 1) Priya + Jordan draft tech design and effort estimate by Wed. 2) Maria to draft contract addendum for export liability + retention tiers by Wed. 3) Security (Samir) to provide gating checklist. 4) Demo w/ pilot customer next Tue.
priya: Ack. I’ll start an RFC today and paste link here.
alex.m: Thanks — if anyone has pushback on 90d-onramp vs 30d let’s raise now. pilot customers asked specifically for >60d so 90d seems safe. :thumbsup:
jordan: +1 from infra. 90d OK for pilot but long-term tiers still needed.
samir (security): fine for pilot. Keep export integrity checks non-optional.
maria (legal): fine — will aim for neutral language that protects both sides.
ops-bot: reminder — create incident runbook for export failures (template: /runbooks/export-failures)
alex.m: Cool — closing this sync. I’ll follow up with sprint tickets and pilot acceptance criteria.
